rules:
- Participation Requirements -
· Endministrator Authority Level ≥ 30

- Event Rules -
· During the event, you can select any combination of Test Criteria before starting the combat challenge.
· The combat challenge has a total of 4 waves. Defeat all enemies to beat the challenge. If you fail the challenge, the challenge must be re-attempted from the beginning.
· Test Criteria are a series of effects that make the challenge more difficult. They are divided into these difficulty ratings: 1 / 2 / 3. Total Test Criteria is the sum of difficulty rating of all selected Test Criteria.
· Test Criteria are also divided into regional "Criteria Sets". Complete challenges at higher Total Test Criteria to unlock more Criteria Sets.
· Some Test Criteria are [Locked Criteria] that cannot be selected by default. Select the specified [Key Criteria] to unlock them.

- Event Rewards -
· Complete event mission goals to earn rewards such as Vitrified Coins. Successfully completing a Test Criterion for the first time also rewards Vitrified Coins.
· Vitrified Coins can be exchanged at the [Secret Sanctuary] for rewards.

- Sanctuary Rating -
· [Sanctuary Rating] represents your current best challenge record in terms of Total Test Criteria. Sanctuary Rating will be displayed at Friends-related screens.
· Successfully completing a challenge with Total Test Criteria of at least 1 activates [Sanctuary Rating] for the event.
· [Sanctuary Rating] for this Contingency Contract event will only be active for the duration of the said event.

- Event Updates -
· After event launch, an update will be applied on day 8 at 12:00 (server time). This adds a new batch of Test Criteria. The new Test Criteria cannot be selected if their Criteria Set is still locked.
· After event launch, another update will be applied every 3 days at 04:00 (server time) to update and add 1 cycle mission.
· All Contingency Contract missions will be available until the end of the event.

- End of the Event -
· This is a limited-time event that will end at the specified time.
· After the event ends, combat challenges can no longer be attempted. Mission progress will not be updated as well.
· After the event ends, the [Secret Sanctuary] will remain open for a while so that the remaining rewards can be exchanged. Once the [Secret Sanctuary] closes, all unused Vitrified Coins earned during the event will be removed.
feature:
- The enemies are various types of Aggeloi.
- Some enemies apply Cryo Infliction to operators. An operator who reaches 4 Cryo Infliction stacks becomes solidified.
stageRules:
- The operation comprises 4 consecutive enemy waves to fight. Defeat all enemy waves to complete the operation.
- Healing Masses will be dropped between the waves. Touch them to restore HP to every teammate.
- There is a resting session between waves, during which the operators are still considered to be in battle.
- The operation has a countdown timer. Once the timer ends or all operators in the team are reduced to ZERO HP, the operation is interrupted.
- Tacticals and consumables cannot be used.

criteria.name: Team: Weaken I

criteria.name: Team: Weaken II

criteria.desc: Operator Attributes -10%/-20%/-40%.

criteria.name: Edit: Thrill I
criteria.desc: DMG Dealt by enemies +30%/-80%.

criteria.name: Edit: Thrill II
criteria.desc: DMG Dealt by enemies +30%/+80%.

criteria.name: Team: Restraint I
criteria.desc: When an operator applies Vulnerability or Arts Infliction stacks, DMG Dealt (of the corresponding type) by the said operator -45%/-90%.

criteria.name: Team: Restraint II
criteria.desc: When an operator applies Vulnerability or Arts Infliction stacks, DMG Dealt (of the corresponding type) by the said operator -45%/-90%.

criteria.name: Team: Decapitate I
criteria.desc: DMG Taken by the controlled operator +50%/+100%.

criteria.name: Team: Decapitate II
criteria.desc: DMG Taken by the controlled operator +50%/+100%.

criteria.name: Ambient: Hypoxia
criteria.desc: Stamina Regeneration Rate -50%.

criteria.name: Ambient: Mire
criteria.desc: Dodge cannot be performed.

criteria.name: Ambient: Withering I
criteria.desc: Only 1 Healing Mass is generated between waves.

criteria.name: Ambient: Withering II
criteria.desc: No Healing Masses are generated between waves.

criteria.name: Team: Bent Edges I
criteria.desc: When an operator casts an ultimate, Ultimate DMG Dealt by the said operator's subsequent ultimates -50%/-100%.

criteria.name: Team: Bent Edges II
criteria.desc: When an operator casts an ultimate, Ultimate DMG Dealt by the said operator's subsequent ultimates -50%/-100%.

criteria.name: Edit: Effect Barrier
criteria.desc: Vulnerability or Arts Infliction of the same element can only be applied to the same enemy once every 5s.

criteria.name: Edit: Rush
criteria.desc: Enemy Movement Speed +100%. Enemies do not suffer more than 25% Max HP of DMG within 0.1s.

criteria.name: Team: Poor Basics
criteria.desc: Operator's Basic Attack DMG Dealt -70%.

criteria.name: Team: Encumbered
criteria.desc: Natural SP Recovery is temporarily paused when the controlled operator has not dealt a Final Strike to the enemy for 12 seconds.

criteria.name: Ambient: Synced Growth
criteria.desc: When the controlled operator is restored for 10% Max HP or acquires a shield with 20% Max HP, every enemy in the battlefield is also restored for 8% Max HP.

criteria.name: Team: Whittle Down
criteria.desc: When operators take DMG, part of that DMG will be converted to Max HP Reductions. Conversion rates: 30% (for melee operators) / 50% (for ranged operators)

criteria.name: Ambient: Overclock
criteria.desc: Length of Operator Combo Skill Cooldown -60%. Battle Skill DMG Dealt -60%.

criteria.name: Ambient: Tremor
criteria.desc: Operator's DMG Dealt +100% for any DMG not dealt by Basic Attack, Battle Skill, Combo Skill, or Ultimate. Battle Skill DMG Dealt -60%.

criteria.name: Edit: Encasement
criteria.desc: For each Vulnerability or Arts Infliction stack that an enemy has, the enemy receives DMG Taken (of the corresponding type) -10%. This effect is removed 0.1s after the Vulnerability or Arts Infliction ends.

criteria.name: Ambient: Partition
criteria.desc: Cannot switch controlled operator once battle begins.

criteria.name: Edit: Toxic Residue I
criteria.desc: A defeated enemy will leave a patch of toxins on the battlefield. Operators caught within the patch take {{Color|-2%}} of their Max HP of DMG every second.

criteria.name: Edit: Toxic Residue II
criteria.desc: A defeated enemy leaves a Toxic Puddle on the ground. Operators caught in the patch take 2%/5% of their Max HP every second.

criteria.name: Team: Battle Chill I
criteria.desc: Whenever operators cast battle skill 2/1 time(s), apply 1 stack of Cryo Infliction to the controlled operator. Effect trigger cooldown for each operator: 3s.

criteria.name: Team: Battle Chill II
criteria.desc:
Whenever operators cast battle skill 2/1 time(s), apply 1 stack of Cryo Infliction to the controlled operator.
Effect trigger cooldown for each operator: 3s.

criteria.name: Team: Heat Loss I
criteria.desc: Whenever operators cast combo skill 2/1 time(s), apply 1 stack of Cryo Infliction to the controlled operator. Effect trigger cooldown for each operator: 3s.

criteria.name: Team: Heat Loss II
criteria.desc:
Whenever operators cast combo skill 2/1 time(s), apply 1 stack of Cryo Infliction to the controlled operator.
Effect trigger cooldown for each operator: 3s.

criteria.name: Ambient: Thermolysis
criteria.desc: Duration of Solidification extended to 15s. Casting Heat-type skills can dispel the Solidification.

criteria.name: Edit: Flashfreeze
criteria.desc: If an enemy applies Cryo Infliction to the controlled operator, directly convert the effect to Solidification instead.

criteria.name: Ambient: Biolysis
criteria.desc: Duration of Solidification extended to 15s. Casting Nature-type skills can dispel the Solidification.

criteria.name: Ambient: Electrolysis
criteria.desc: Duration of Solidification extended to 15s. Casting Electric-type skills can dispel the Solidification.

criteria.name: Ambient: Physicolysis
criteria.desc: Duration of Solidification extended to 15s. Casting Physical-type skills can dispel the Solidification.

criteria.name: Edit: Regeneration I
criteria.desc: An enemy under crowd control effects regenerates 5%/15% Max HP per second.

criteria.name: Edit: Regeneration II
criteria.desc: An enemy under crowd control effects regenerates 5%/15% Max HP per second.

criteria.name: Ambient: RE-Construct I
criteria.desc: Heavy Ram and Heavy Sting enemies in the final wave are replaced by Heavy Ram α and Heavy Sting α.

criteria.name: Ambient: RE-Construct II
criteria.desc: Heavy Ram and Heavy Sting enemies in the third and fourth waves are replaced by Heavy Ram α and Heavy Sting α.

variants.note: Final-wave Heavy Ram and Heavy Sting become their α forms, likely Ambient: RE-Construct I
Third and fourth wave Heavy Ram and Heavy Sting become their α forms, likely Ambient: RE-Construct II

eny_0021_agmelee.name: Ram
abilities: This enemy has no special abilities.
eny_0021_agmelee.desc: The "Kriosson" (archive ID: ACL071) is amongst the earliest recorded form of the Aggeloi and the most commonly encountered. It attacks by ramming its victims with its horns.

eny_0076_agfly.name: Falsewings
abilities: Launches small whirlwinds that can also slow down operators.
eny_0076_agfly.desc: The "Psuthopteron" (archive ID: ARA07C) has flight capabilities that are wholly unrelated to its morphology. This pattern was originally regarded as biomimicry. However, the modern consensus believes it was a mimic of Terran flying vehicles.

eny_0027_agscorp.name: Heavy Sting
abilities: This enemy attacks by causing Originium pillars to erupt under the operators.
When approached, this enemy will summon stone pillars around itself for protection.
eny_0027_agscorp.desc: The "Varykentron" (archive ID: ARL141) is a non-standard variant of ARL121. It would occasionally perform whip attacks with its tail instead of using its ranged energy attack.

eny_0087_wgslime.name: Mudflow
abilities: This enemy can quickly close the distance from afar. Its attacks can apply Cryo Infliction to operators upon hit.
eny_0087_wgslime.desc: The "Tholeroygran" (archive ID: ACM311) is the first fluid-based pattern to be discovered. The morphology of the halo is unstable and the internal temperature is typically lower than its constituent materials.

eny_0088_wgthorns.name: Hedron
abilities: The projectiles it launches apply Cryo Infliction to operators upon hit.
eny_0088_wgthorns.desc: The "Diaphaistagran" (archive ID: ARM315) is a fluid-based pattern with energy projecting capabilities. Its shape is that of a complex yet symmetrical geometry. Its attacks can also sap heat from any surface they come in contact with.

eny_0089_wgreflec.name: Prism
abilities: This enemy can greatly strengthen nearby allies to improve their capabilities.
eny_0089_wgreflec.desc: The "Prismastagran" (archive ID: ASM316) is a non-model variant of ARM315. It is capable of protecting nearby Aggeloi, and is very difficult to hit as it often surrounds itself with ARM315 entities.

eny_0091_wgshoal.name: Tidewalker
abilities: Attacks with abilities that apply Cryo Infliction, and applies Solidification to operators it hits.
eny_0091_wgshoal.desc: The "Genesklydan" (archive ID: AGM321) exhibits humanoid head and legs. Ever since the discovery of this particular pattern, human resemblance became an unspoken rule for assessing Aggeloid threat levels.

eny_0023_aghornb.name: Heavy Ram
abilities: This enemy has no special abilities.
eny_0023_aghornb.desc: The "Thrylissoron" (archive ID: ACL072) is a non-standard variant of ACL071. It can manipulate its environment and make tactical decisions.

eny_0058_agdisk.name: Effigy
abilities: This enemy has powerful slam attacks but rotates slowly during casting. This is the best time to go behind it and attack.
The enemy can reassemble its body in various forms and move quickly across the battlefield.
The enemy will attempt to trap the operators! Quick interruption will counter it.
eny_0058_agdisk.desc: The "Homoiossaron" (archive ID: AGL371) is capable of mimicking human forms or parts thereof. Some of these rare and dangerous entities are capable of channeling the Æther itself.

eny_0090_wgabyss.name: Tidalklast
abilities: The enemy has two states: Ranged and Melee.
Melee State: In this state, the enemy will try to approach the target to unleash melee attacks.
Ranged State: In this state, the enemy will maintain its distance and attack with more powerful abilities.
The ranged state suffers more Heat DMG, but has significant DMG Reduction against other elements.
eny_0090_wgabyss.desc: The "Anavatklydan" (archive ID: AGM32L) is a non-model variant of AGM321. Such entities come in a wide range of sizes. The sight of particularly large individuals breaking out of the water has become a nightmare for those who witnessed it.

eny_0069_aghornb2.name: Heavy Ram α
abilities: This enemy has no special abilities.
eny_0069_aghornb2.desc: The "Thrylissoron Anavon" (archive ID: ACL072α) is an energized variant of ACL072. Its high energy contents did not affect its decision-making abilities. This entity is extremely dangerous.

eny_0070_agscorp2.name: Heavy Sting α
abilities: This enemy attacks by causing Originium pillars to erupt under the operators.
When approached, this enemy will summon stone pillars around itself for protection.
eny_0070_agscorp2.desc: The "Varykentron Anavon" (archive ID: ARL141α) is an energized variant of ARL141 that has retained a plethora of attack patterns. It is a tougher and more dangerous entity.
